newsitem.title: USA: Boyd Gaming president to retire.
newsitem.headline: Boyd Gaming president to retire.

text.p: Boyd Gaming Corp said Tuesday its president and board member Charles Ruthe will retire on January 1.
Boyd Gaming said in a statement Ruthe is leaving to spend more time with his family and to devote more time to serve on other public boards of directors. A replacement was not named.
Ruthe will become a consultant to Boyd Gaming on real estate transactions, business development issues and charitable activities. Ruthe joined the company in 1983 and became president in 1988.
